thread:
hana: random pet drop! Oscar perfected the "nose boop" this morning. evidence attached 60a https://files.redwood.example/oscar-nose-boop.jpg
diego: that is an Olympic-level boop. training regime? :medal: (reacted with :heart:)
pri: question: is the boop hereditary or taught? we must know for science.
katie: scientific method: replicate boop. will bring snacks as incentive.
hana: recap: 1) woke up 2) found Oscar perched on the windowsill 3) tapped nose twice 4) boop executed with precision and a micro-purr.
diego: can we get a slo-mo? the angles matter.
pri: also the tilt. don't forget the tilt. crucial.
katie: gif incoming...
giphy-bot: (posted slow-mo nose boop gif) https://giphy.example/boop-slo-mo.gif
diego: PERFECT. frame-by-frame we can see the whisker ripple.
hana: never thought i'd feel emotional about whisker physics.
pri: proposal: Pet Trick Friday next week? each pet gets 30 seconds to show off. low-pressure, high smiles.
katie: i'm in. my plant does a convincing leaf wave.
diego: RSVP yes. Oscar will accept cookies as appearance fee.
hana: update: Oscar demands curtain applause. consider curtains ready. :clap:
